description: Read archived crypto headlines, newest first, with source links. Use news_recent for live headlines. Paginate with nextBefore (ISO timestamp). Archive coverage starts when Basis began collecting; an empty page does not prove no news occurred. No full article text.

asset.description: Base asset, e.g. BTC; supported asset tags only.

before.description: A date or timestamp, e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z. UTC unless it says otherwise.

name: news_history
